errors.text: The proposed intervention is generic alloying-induced distortion rather than controlled chemical short-range ordering in random bcc HfNbTaTiZr.
The predicted conductivity decrease is opposite to the target result: short-range order increases lattice thermal conductivity by about 12%.
The mechanism omits reduced atomic displacement, B2-like HfTi/TiZr clusters, percolative heat-transport pathways, and phonon-density-of-states changes.
Both cited papers are unrelated to phonon thermal conductivity or lattice-distortion engineering, so they provide no valid support.
Changing alloying to vary distortion also changes composition and other transport variables, preventing clean attribution without composition-matched controls.
